scope.selection: First 30 registration IDs in sorted manifest order excluding the previous 20 source-review records.

notes: This file supplements, and does not modify, the pinned previous 20-record source review.
Checked includes retrieval attempts: 30 checked is not 30 verified or newly enriched guides.
Reviewed date is not source publication date or direct-server capture time. Parsed and indexed content may be cached.
All proposed facts describe attributed business offerings, not individual expertise, legal identity, licenses, availability or publication approval.
Fact lists do not authorize a Cartesian product. Only explicitly labeled single-trip sections preserve a direct source-stated relationship.
Held observations are diagnostic research notes only. Failed retrieval does not mean a business is closed.
No reviews, private contacts, pricing, credentials, public application data, or live services were changed.
